content.text: The renewal terms meet the preferred position in full.

input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: Renewal terms are twelve months (not multi-year), Customer may opt out on thirty days' written notice (well inside the ≤30-day preferred window), and Vendor must send a renewal reminder sixty days beforehand, with the opt-out deadline extended if the reminder is late — an added protection for us. Section 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and three percent, with ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods, matching the preferred cap. This clause sits at the preferred position; no redline needed.
